entries.126e401b5fdf27dd: Sumitomo Realty & Development Co., Ltd. is a company that prepares land through redevelopment methods — buying up fragmented land in central Tokyo and adjusting the rights relationships of landowners — builds office buildings there, continues to hold them without selling, and accumulates rental income. The company calls this the “power to create land,” and explains that it has maintained a policy of continuing development, ownership and leasing without pursuing temporary profits from asset sales. This real estate leasing business accounts for nearly 7-tenths of operating profit, and added to it are the real estate sales business, which develops and sells condominiums, the housing business, which rebuilds and newly builds other people's homes, and the Step business, which brokers sales and purchases of other people's real estate. The housing business and the Step business do not own real estate themselves; they are order-based businesses that receive orders for construction and brokerage from owners and sellers and obtain consideration.
